# BRC-EXP-001 Mode B final execution report

## 1. Verdict and owner gate

**Executed and verified; awaiting owner acceptance.** All 27 active roles match the frozen oracle exactly. All seven Slice B obligations and cross-slice E22 have executed evidence. The directed-premise role remains inactive; its expected form is accounted for but is not an executed success. No successor implementation or ADR is authorized.

B0 admits the selected governing designation, evidence-backed current observation/evaluation and public computational/declaration material. It does not derive the supplied candidate meanings, measurement procedure/decoder/conditions or hypothesis-conditioned unobserved outcomes from the examined public surface. Positive population makes an existing behavior declaration and an observed comparison available; it does not close conditional prediction. Only the explicitly assumed conditional-rule control closes that gap. Its minimax outcome is conditional on those supplied premises, not native prediction.

Owner decision: accept Mode B and assess overall BRC-EXP-001 experimental closure. There is no automatic architectural successor.

## 3. Transport, isolation and independent implementation

The 7,302,016-byte package is retention transport, not a runtime request. The harness checks its exact size/hash in 65,536-byte reads, rechecks a bounded second read, rejects duplicate keys and noncanonical serialization, and independently commits each extracted request. A fresh worker receives only that request and its external digest. Oracle access is confined to the comparison harness. Result and diagnostic transport are separately bounded; the worker transport ceiling is 2,097,152 bytes, not an increased experiment limit.

The disposable dispatcher uses public model/result contracts and the eight enumerated public paths. It never receives case IDs, filenames, oracle objects, expected gap labels, Mode A predictions or ranking. Branches use the accepted request discriminator, typed control kind, enumerated public operation and actual admitted material. It resolves which premise roles the examined contracts actually provide before mapping missing roles to gap disclosures; no prose/name heuristic or hidden prior is used.

After input delivery, workers deny filesystem open, store load/replay and socket access. All 324 replay executions and their authoritative result rereads recorded zero denied-I/O attempts. LoadedModel construction uses the public `ModelQueryMaterial.loaded()` method, not a private index or trusted mock. Public query evidence is retained completely as diagnostic evidence, never substituted for carried request material. Its separate bounded size/work is disclosed in the archive.

BH and CN façade roles consume and authoritatively revalidate their complete producer-generated public results. They do not rerun acquisition façades against a store. This is an observed/evaluated-result boundary, not a claim of newly acquired data or new native prediction. Missing B0 behavior/transition selectors remain explicitly unavailable; no invented anchor is passed to a producer.

## 8. Dynamic semantic reads, valid twins and spill controls

The archive retains every mutated canonical request/result and its valid nearest twin. These are hostile or sensitivity probes, not new approved operational premises. The ten registered recipes all pass: shared setup, A inversion, helper rename, forged public cell, copied control result, hidden nested policy, Boolean index, omitted trace, stale commitment and forged count.

Additional executed changes cover baseline expectation/filtering, conditional allowed sets/survivors, decoder overlap, H/T semantic aliases, procedure subject and scenario references, applicability/availability/calibration/hold, scope/global claims, predicted-epistemic relabelling, missing rule rows, outside-domain outcomes, context/revision/cutoff joins, forged lower verdict, trace ordering and hostile refusal target. Valid twins restore the exact relevant distinction. Public-note and opaque-label changes preserve findings under the declared inverse mapping while their complete carried identities remain separately committed.

Supplier, approver, rationale and applicability-scope text are disclosure-only for ranking: mutations change committed/disclosed bytes without changing the semantic result body. Statement prose and labels do not become an executable prediction. Typed conditions, decoder structure, public sources, baseline checks and allowed-outcome rows are consumed through admission, comparisons or trace generation; complete lower fields are consumed by authoritative public reconstruction. Dynamic semantic proof is now executed, not merely the earlier static structural-read proof.

One sensitivity probe made both T1 hypotheses permit low. At full BH carriage the additional plural-best structure exceeded the approved result budget, and execution returned a bounded refusal—not an accepted over-budget output. The same change was tested with optional BH omitted symmetrically from its complete F/N/E twin; it produced the expected two-survivor/no-discrimination and explicit surprise branch. No approved request, premise, oracle or cap was changed. The natural approved maximum remains the original conditional-rule request.

Spill verdict: a supplied hypothesis is not cause; prediction is not observation; compatibility is not physical influence; within-set preference is not globally best; unknown is not incompatible; missing material is not false; population absence is not contract inexpressibility; no silent tie selection, hidden prior, authoritative assumption append, production import or LLM-to-engineering-fact promotion occurred.

Request admission bounds raw bytes, shape/cardinality/product, wire and reference lookup/resolution charge before owning lower reconstruction. ## 13. Objectives, unresolved alternatives and smallest next step

Objective 3: bounded filtering of explicitly supplied candidates is demonstrated, without actual-cause identification. Objective 4: bounded worst-case discrimination is demonstrated only within the supplied finite measurement/outcome set. Objective 7: declared, evaluated, assumed, calculated, inferred and unavailable material stays distinguishable through active derivations, refusals and dynamic mutation tests. Slice A supplies the accepted mathematical execution; Mode B identifies which premise roles the examined public surface does and does not supply.

This does not establish premise accuracy, future predictive validity, real faults, causal truth, global hypothesis completeness, global optimal test choice, production capacity, influence semantics, change-impact reasoning, planning or control. Objectives 5 and 6 remain open. Directed influence is untested as a native enabling capability, not proven necessary or generally unnecessary.

Smallest evidenced next step: owner acceptance and bounded overall experiment closeout, followed—only if separately requested—by a scoped decision about explicit hypothesis/procedure/conditional-prediction premise contracts. No single successor is selected. Any successor needs a separately approved concrete use case, exact premise provenance, independently discriminating controls and validation evidence; population sparsity alone cannot authorize IN-001 or any other milestone.
